scientific_integrity.computation: Independent bounded rolling-window enumeration; not relied upon to establish the unrestricted theorem.
scientific_integrity.novelty: Qualified best-knowledge claim, not exhaustive historical-priority certification.
scientific_integrity.proof: Complete elementary proof for every finite binary input and every substitution rank.

scientific_limitations: The period-doubling formula is for complete finite substitution iterates, not arbitrary prefixes.
Circular factors have length at most one whole traversal and are classified by Parikh vector, not by spelling or multiplicity.
The lengthwise recurrences are exact but not a closed nonrecursive digit expression.
The related 2016 binary-uniform-morphism article was not available in full text; historical-priority uncertainty remains.
title: Circular Abelian transport and an exact period-doubling spectrum
